rationale: Base station storage is at 99% with loop recording disabled, active error E-402, and a solid purple LED (storage >95%). This matches the customer's symptom exactly: the timeline stops at the end of last month because new events stopped being recorded once storage hit 98%. Live view and notifications still work because those don't require local recording. The standard L1 fix (enable loop recording) has been applied; the customer should also export/format to reclaim space, but the root cause is confirmed.

repair_steps: Confirm loop recording is enabled on the base station.
Advise customer to export any important clips, then format storage to reclaim space.
Verify new events are being recorded and timeline updates.
output.customer_reply: We've enabled loop recording on your base station, so new events will now be saved. To free up space, please export any important clips and then format the storage. Your system should now record normally. If you need further help, let us know.

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.
